positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Tech lead on the Neutral Clean Room team building privacy-centric measurement and audiences products.
- Led the project to embed Google Tag Manager integration into the LinkedIn Conversions API (CAPI) to improve signal collection.
- Led Revenue Attribution Report enabling advertisers get insights into how LinkedIn helps drive their company leads and revenue which in turns helps improve budget allocation, targeting and ads campaign optimization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working in LinkedIn Marketing Solutions as part of the Member Experience Sponsored Messaging team.

Leading the UI work for Sponsored Messages Member Experience.
Working on adding additional Kafka tracking events for Sponsored Messages to provide the advertisers with more detailed insights about their ad campaigns.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the Ads (Sponsored InMail) team at LinkedIn, focusing on the development of a new conversation ad format supporting both advertiser and member experience.
Added Years of Experience targeting facet in the LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
Worked on the Self Service Sponsored Inmail project to make the sponsored Inmails self serve for advertisers.
Worked on building Lead Generation Forms ads for the LinkedIn Campaign Manager and also it's rendering in LinkedIn feed and messages. The form contains prefilled data from member's profile which makes it easier for members to submit the forms.
Completed all UI work for Sponsored InMail multi-faceted Vector migration to comply with the new GDPR requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
As part of the Data Science (Search & Discovery) team, I worked on improving the search relevance and performance of the Ticketmaster Search service. Also, worked on developing Discovery API of Ticketmaster.
I indexed the ticketmaster data using Elastic Search and aggregated the data to generate a Kibana dashboard.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on a project Discovery Math for Discovery Education.
Developed interactive web-based applications (Equation Parser, Graphing Tool and Dynamic Geometry Tool) for desktops and tablets using HTML5, CSS3, JS and various JS libraries  like Backbone.js, Handlebars.js, Bootstrap.js, Paper.js.
Also performed unit testing of the code using Jasmine.js.

projects.title: TagsForFollowers: Analysing the usage of hashtags to seek followers
projects.description: Recently, there has been an increased usage of tags like #follow4follow, #followme, etc. on Instagram, for connecting users for the purpose of increasing the number of followers or likes received for the given photo or video. The project aims at analyzing the usage and effectiveness of these hashtags and also identify the factors that influence the increase in followers.

projects.title: Disaster Notification System using Twitter API
projects.description: Analyzing the tweets using Apache Spark Streaming in Java to extract information related to disaster from the tweets and send alerts to the nearby areas, if disaster has occurred

publications.title: Speed Control Mechanism Using Terrain Detection
